summary.zh: 写用户故事与验收标准，拆分史诗并排优先级
summary.en: Writes user stories, splits epics and sets priority

description.zh: 面向产品待办：撰写用户故事和验收标准，把大史诗拆成可交付的小块，估算工作量并为冲刺排序。适合迭代计划会前准备待办，或需求太粗需要落地时使用。
description.en: Handles backlog work: writes user stories and acceptance criteria, splits epics into deliverable slices, and estimates or prioritizes them for a sprint. Useful before planning meetings or when requirements are too rough.
